check_IsKeyword: check if a given token is a C++ keyword using the IsKeyword function
check_IsBuiltinType: check if a given token is a C++ builtin type using the IsBuiltinType function
list_ALL_keywords: list all C++ keywords by importing and printing the ALL set from the module
list_TYPES: list all C++ type keywords by importing and printing the TYPES set from the module
list_CONTROL_keywords: list all C++ control flow keywords by importing and printing the CONTROL set from the module
